text:
Lab report:

Measured: E1 at 0.39 +/-0.01 m, reliable, no problems or warnings, 602 frames, 16.3 cycles. Period 1.24798 +/-0.00051 s, zero-crossing check 1.24765 s (agreement 0.48 sigma). Amplitude 11.1 deg, small-angle T0 1.24598 +/-0.00051 s, Q 124.2, damping rate 0.0203 /s.

Damping: viscous wins (delta_AIC 0.0, weight 0.862, rms 4.55 px). Coulomb second (delta 3.76, weight 0.132), quadratic rejected (delta 9.74, weight 0.007), undamped rejected (delta 900.78, rms 9.64 px). Difference 3.76 >2, so viscous distinguished.

g: 9.9175 +/-0.2544 m/s2 from E1 alone, no length-offset fit (only 1 distinct length). Uncertainty dominated by length error.

Prediction P1 registered for unmeasured length 0.65 m at 11.0 deg: T0 1.60855 +/-0.02096 s, period at amplitude 1.61226 +/-0.02101 s. Request sent to human for 0.65 m, ~11 deg, >=15 cycles. No verification yet - no experiment added after P1.

Next step: record the 0.65 m experiment, then add a third length to allow offset fit.
